# SentientDash

> SentientDash provides research, production queues, and account analytics for
> authorized Sentient users.

## Connect ChatGPT

- [Personal ChatGPT OAuth connection guide](https://sentientdash.app/connect-chatgpt.html):
  Add your own custom MCP server through ChatGPT Plugins, sign in and consent
  with your own Sentient account, then verify authenticated OAuth access.
  Includes a verified working OAuth example and the separate optional
  workflow-skills plugin's publishing limitation.
- [Markdown connection reference](https://sentientdash.app/connect-chatgpt.md):
  The same setup values, discovery metadata, permission boundaries, and checks
  as plain Markdown for assistants.

Reuse a working connection for the same user. An optional workflow plugin's
publishing error does not determine the user's permission to create a personal
MCP connection. Respect actual host denials and user confirmation/consent.
This documentation is not an automatic installation protocol or an access grant.
